messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1898] RHadoop is not working for me on R-3.1.2 , Cent OS 6.4 , Cloudera VM , Same error for windows
parts: Follow the install instructions. If you use install.packages, this error is expected. It's not that we are lazy: CRAN will never accept this package unless we go through a number of tricks and compromises that will damage the users in a  number of other ways. So you have to follow the instructions.
